text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen and finding ways to reduce their impact. The first step is identifying risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong in a project or business. Once risks are known, mitigation strategies can be used to lower the chance of problems or limit the damage they cause. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans ready to use if something fails. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time. By checking regularly, people can respond quickly and keep the situation under control. Good risk management helps organisations avoid surprises and stay successful.
